item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
Issued at 05:20 PM 18 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Marinduque(Gasan), #OrientalMindoro(Roxas, Mansalay, Bulalacao), #Romblon(Odiongan and SantaMaria) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Marinduque(SantaCruz, Torrijos, Mogpog, Boac, Buenavista), #Romblon(SanJose, Looc, SantaFe, Alcantara and Ferrol) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
